_comment: Kalshi integration settings. Data, not code: change a number here, not a constant in collector/kalshi.py or web/lib/kalshi.ts. Both read this file.
_blockedStates: Kalshi sports contracts are under a preliminary injunction in Michigan (Ingham County, 2026-09-01). Flags 2 and 3 are computed and shadow-logged for blocked states but never shown. Remove a state here to turn them on.
_thin: A market is a fair-price reference only when yes bid/ask are at most 3 cents apart and both best levels hold at least 100 contracts. Otherwise it is marked thin and no flag uses it.
_fee: Taker fee per contract = coefficient x price x (1 - price), rounded up to the next cent per order. The football game series are fee_type quadratic_with_maker_fees, so resting orders pay a fee too; only the taker side is used here (buying at the ask). Confirm against Kalshi's fee schedule before relying on a flag.
_flags: staleBook: a sportsbook's no-vig chance sits this many points below Kalshi's fair midpoint. kalshiValue: Kalshi's fee-adjusted ask is this many points below the sportsbook consensus fair chance. arb: a sportsbook price on one side plus Kalshi's fee-adjusted price on the other cost at least this many points under 100%.
